title: UE-initiated authentication and key agreement procedure initiation

entities.name: UE-initiated authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE upon receiving ProSe direct link establishment request to establish secure PC5 unicast link via 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay.

entities.name: RELAY KEY REQUEST
entities.description: Message created by UE to request relay keys for secure PC5 unicast link establishment.

entities.name: PRTI
entities.description: ProSe Relay Temporary Identifier allocated by UE for the relay session.

entities.name: relay key request parameters
entities.description: Contains SUCI, relay service code, and nonce_1 received from the 5G ProSe remote UE.

entities.name: T35xx
entities.description: Timer started by UE upon sending RELAY KEY REQUEST message.

entities.name: ProSe direct link establishment request received
entities.description: Trigger condition when UE receives ProSe direct link establishment request including SUCI from 5G ProSe remote UE.

relations.description: Procedure initiation is triggered by receiving ProSe direct link establishment request.
Procedure includes creating and sending RELAY KEY REQUEST message.
RELAY KEY REQUEST message contains PRTI IE set to allocated PRTI value.
RELAY KEY REQUEST message contains relay key request parameters IE with SUCI, relay service code, and nonce_1.
Procedure starts timer T35xx upon sending RELAY KEY REQUEST message.
